claim: A 128K snapshot paused in BASIC can be stepped to its USR with a key held, or started at the USR address; check PC, the stack and PROG before believing the game needs ROM.

evidence.text: The PAUSE/USR path runs through the 128 editor and the 0x5B00 ROM-switching code, which NEXLOAD overwrites; the snapshot stops at PC 0x1F3D.
Stepped with a key held to PC 0x6C00; the .nex starts there and 39 bytes go in SIT1.
